## Project Overview

Write about 100 - 150 words describing your project. This description will change over the semester, so each time you make a deliverable, you might need to update it.  Each time, do your best to be accurate to the focus of the project _as it is that that moment_

9/27: Right now, my project is focusing on the location of prisons, the demographics of the areas around them, and what the reasoning is behind placing a prison there. We are in the researching phase, so a thesis has not been made yet. However, I have several hypotheses, which have guided my research. Perhaps prisons are built to exploit black and Brown people and their labor—racism is the underlying cause of a lot of issues in the U.S. Or perhaps the cause is increased incarceration, which follow policies that our politicians introduce. I am also interested to see if prisons are clustered together, or if they are spread apart and in rural areas. I still need to find a dataset for the locations of prisons, and once I do, I can gather more information and formulate a thesis.
